title: Discover operation usage, pagination and stable errors
preconditions: No Saga need be opened for discovery; use the query schema/spec operations advertised by CLI help.

steps.action: For each operation enumerated by TestQuerySchemaDescribesEveryResponseWithoutOpeningSession, decode query schema OP.
steps.expected_result: Operation identity, expected data path and cursor counted/total paths match the table.

steps.action: Read schema for personas, persona-references, terms, term-references and spec --json.
steps.expected_result: Schema has usage and cursor pagination; independent reference conflict pagination is described; spec has the versioned query schema and persona/reference operations.

steps.action: For every query operation inspect query schema OP and query OP --help.
steps.expected_result: Purpose, usage/input flags, data paths and pagination metadata are published.

steps.action: Inspect spec --json and query help stable error discovery.
steps.expected_result: All operations and their input shapes are discoverable with stable error code/retryability contracts.

expected_result: An AI client can discover the supported contract without scraping storage or prose results.
